17191.summary: Trap that returns a card you control to the hand; while in the GY it can Set itself and bounce a face-up card you control, with a same-name activation lock for the rest of the turn.

22926.summary: Level 6 monster that can be Tribute Summoned with extra Tributes to place VIP Counters, and can remove a counter to coin-flip negate an opponent's effect (halving its ATK on a wrong call).

22927.summary: Can Special Summon itself from the hand by turning a face-up monster into a Spellcaster and granting it destruction protection, at the cost of locking your Extra Deck to Spellcasters; if Tributed or banished for a Spellcaster's effect it returns to your hand.

22928.summary: Level 4 Machine that can Tribute itself to summon a Machine monster from the Deck whose ATK equals its DEF (returned to hand in the End Phase), or banish itself from the GY with a discard to make an "Iron Rubble Token".

22929.summary: Can Special Summon itself from the hand by banishing Machine Link Monsters whose combined Link Ratings equal exactly 5 from the Extra Deck, and can bounce one of your cards and one of your opponent's cards with a Quick Effect while linked.

22930.summary: Can discard a card to Special Summon itself from the hand, banish itself from the GY to revive a Zombie monster, and later attach itself to a Zombie Xyz Monster.

22931.summary: Rank 6 Xyz that can revive a Zombie from your GY during either Main Phase while weakening an opposing monster, and shuffles a monster from either GY into the Deck when sent to the GY.

22932.summary: Reveal it in hand to Special Summon a "GMX" or Dinosaur monster from hand, then when Special Summoned by a monster effect it revives a Level 4 or lower "GMX" or Dinosaur monster from hand, GY or banishment.

22933.summary: Can Special Summon itself from the hand while you control a "GMX" or Dinosaur monster, and can excavate until a Dinosaur to send it to the GY and turn a face-up monster into a Dinosaur for the turn.

22934.summary: Level 10 Fusion Monster that gains effects depending on Dinosaur materials used: protection with 3+, up to 3 attacks with 4+, and 800 damage to the opponent on their Summons with 5+; also once per turn, after a "GMX" excavation, destroys all other monsters.

22935.summary: Fusion Monster that searches a "GMX" card when Special Summoned, and when a "GMX" effect excavates can either gain 1500 LP while on the field or Special Summon itself from the GY.

22936.summary: Fusion Summons a Dinosaur Fusion Monster using hand/field materials (plus a Deck "GMX" monster if opponent controls a monster), and can banish itself from GY to excavate until a "GMX" card and add it to hand.

22937.summary: GMX Lab #5 is a Field Spell that blocks your opponent's responses when you Summon a "GMX" monster, and during your Main Phase can Set a "GMX" Spell/Trap from your Deck while putting a hand card on top of the Deck.

22938.summary: Continuous Trap that can be activated while you control a "GMX" monster and, once per turn, excavates the top 5 cards of your Deck to negate an opponent's on-field monster effect if a "GMX" card was excavated.

22950.summary: Level 8 monster that must be Special Summoned from the hand by shuffling a Spellcaster or Warrior Ritual Monster from hand or GY into the Deck; it can discard itself to place a "Light and Darkness Ritual"-related Continuous Trap from Deck or GY, becomes unaffected by the opponent's activated effects while a Ritual Spell is in the GY, and can banish 2 opponent's cards each Main Phase.

22951.summary: Monster that can Special Summon itself from your hand or GY by placing 3 cards from the GYs or face-up banishment on the bottom of the Deck, and when sent to the GY can send a Ritual Spell to add the Ritual Monster it names.

22952.summary: When Normal or Special Summoned, reveals your hand to potentially draw 3 and discard 2 if you reveal a "Light and Darkness Ritual" card; can Tribute itself to Special Summon a Ritual Monster mentioning "Light and Darkness Ritual" from hand.

22953.summary: Hand trap that discards itself to either make the next battle or effect damage you take this turn become 0, or Set a Quick-Play Spell/Trap mentioning "Light and Darkness Ritual" from the Deck that can be activated that turn; it also counts as the entire Tribute for a Level 8 Ritual Summon.

22954.summary: Level 10 that must be Special Summoned by a "Sacred Beast" card, can reveal itself in hand to search a "Sacred Beast" Trap then discard, gains ATK/DEF per Trap in the GYs, and once per turn destroys a Spell/Trap with no response allowed.

22955.summary: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set and must be Special Summoned by a "Sacred Beast" card; can reveal itself in hand to search a "Sacred Beast" Spell then discard, burns the opponent when monsters are sent to their GY, and prevents all damage for a turn if destroyed.

22956.summary: Sacred Beast boss that must be Special Summoned by a "Sacred Beast" card, can reveal itself in hand to search a "Sacred Beast" monster and then discard a card, and once per turn can Tribute 2 other Sacred Beasts to wipe the opponent's monsters and gain 1000 ATK per destroyed card.

22957.summary: Three once-per-turn effects that Special Summon a "Sacred Beast" monster (except Level 8) in Defense Position from the hand, GY, or by discarding; one from hand, one from hand/GY, one from GY by banishing itself.

22958.summary: When Normal or Special Summoned, places a "Sacred Beast" Field Spell or Continuous Spell/Trap from the Deck face-up on your field; while you control another "Sacred Beast" monster it can summon two more copies of itself, and it can recover itself from the GY during the opponent's End Phase.

22959.summary: Hand trap that, during a turn where your "Blitzclique" card destroyed a card, reveals itself to Special Summon up to 3 Thunder monsters from your hand and can destroy the same number of cards on the field; it can also negate a monster effect activated outside the hand by returning another Thunder monster you control to the hand.

22961.summary: Hand trap that, during your opponent's turn, destroys the monster whose effect was activated, then Special Summons a Thunder monster from your hand while locking you into Special Summoning from the hand for the rest of the turn; while it is on the field it also sends a "Blitzclique" Spell/Trap from your Deck to the GY whenever a card is destroyed.

22962.summary: Can be revealed in hand to destroy a Spell/Trap and Special Summon a Thunder monster from hand, and while on the field searches a "Blitzclique" Spell or "Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb" whenever a card is destroyed by effect.

22967.summary: Hand extender that reveals another "The Phantom Knights" card to Special Summon itself, then on Summon searches a "The Phantom Knights" monster. From the GY it lets an Xyz Monster use its Rank as a Level for an Xyz Summon.

22968.summary: Special Summons itself from the hand while you control no monsters, and on Summon can Set a "The Phantom Knights" Spell/Trap from the Deck; it can also banish itself from the GY to raise the Levels/Ranks of up to 2 Level/Rank 3 DARK monsters you control by 1.

22969.summary: "S-Force" monster that searches another "S-Force" monster when Normal or Special Summoned, draws if the opponent has a monster in its column, and can give all your "S-Force" monsters 1000 ATK when the opponent activates a monster effect in the same column.

22970.summary: Hand trap that Special Summons itself when the opponent Summons, then can Fusion Summon a "Melffy" Fusion Monster; also searches a "Melffy" monster on Summon and can swarm Beast monsters from hand.

22972.summary: Level 7 Thunder that Special Summons itself from hand by returning 1-2 monsters you control to the hand, negates the effects of face-up opponent cards by revealing same number of differently-Leveled monsters in hand when Special Summoned, and returns itself to hand when destroyed by card effect.

22976.summary: Ritual Monster that is unaffected by the opponent's activated effects that do not target it and shields your Spells/Traps from being destroyed or banished; when Special Summoned it recovers a Spell from the GY, and it can banish an opponent's card face-down.

22977.summary: Ritual Monster that is unaffected by your opponent's activated effects unless they target it, and cannot be destroyed by battle. On Special Summon it banishes a card your opponent controls, and when it destroys a monster by battle it gains 1500 ATK and can attack again.

22978.summary: Level 10 Fusion that can also be Special Summoned from the Extra Deck by sending 3 Level 10 monsters that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set to the GY, survives the first two destruction effects each turn, and repeatedly negates an opponent's monster's effects while gaining LP.

22979.summary: Fusion Monster that can revive a Level 6 or lower monster from either GY with its effects negated during the Main Phase, and can banish itself from the GY to Fusion Summon an "Invoked" Fusion Monster using monsters from your field or GY.

22980.summary: Fusion Monster that, when Special Summoned, searches "Virakam, the Divine Spirit of Artifice" or "Gamma Summon" and can banish a monster from either GY; can banish itself from the GY to make your opponent's monsters lose ATK.

22982.summary: A Level 10 Fusion Monster that banishes cards from the field and/or GYs up to the number of materials used when Fusion Summoned, and can change all other monsters' Attributes.

22983.summary: Fusion Monster that bounces an equal number of "Melffy" cards you control and opponent's cards when Fusion Summoned, and can shrink its Level by 2 to revive a Beast monster from your GY when the opponent Summons or targets it for an attack.

22987.summary: Rank 2 Xyz that can be Xyz Summoned over "Melffy Mommy", searches a "Melffy" Spell/Trap on Special Summon, gains ATK from attached "Melffy" monsters, and can detach 5 materials to bounce all of the opponent's cards.

22988.summary: Link 2 that searches a "Theorealize" card when Link Summoned if you have a "Power Patron" monster in the GY, and during either Main Phase can Link Summon a Link Monster using materials you control including itself.

22989.summary: Link 2 monster that searches an "S-Force" Spell/Trap when Special Summoned, and can banish itself and an "S-Force" card from hand to Special Summon an "S-Force" monster from the Deck or Extra Deck.

22990.summary: Link 3 monster that protects itself and stops the opponent from targeting it or Special Summoning by activated monster effects while they control a monster in its column; also a Quick Effect to move a monster to another Main Monster Zone.

22991.summary: Link 2 monster that lets your Tribute Summoned monsters attack twice, and when Tributed can shuffle all Link Monsters on the field and in the GYs into the Extra Deck or make both players shuffle their hands and redraw the same number.

22993.summary: Ritual Spell that Ritual Summons either "Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos" or "Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness" by Tributing and/or banishing monsters, and can recover itself and another related card from the GY.

22994.summary: Quick-Play Spell that returns one of your targeted cards to the hand and destroys a card when the opponent targets your cards, then can Special Summon a "Light and Darkness Ritual" monster; if destroyed by the opponent, it revives a Ritual Monster from hand or Deck.

22995.summary: Quick-Play Spell that, when the opponent activates a monster effect or Normal Spell/Trap, Special Summons 3 differently-named Spells/Traps from your Deck as face-down Defense Position monsters and rewrites the opponent's effect to destroy their own face-down monster.

22996.summary: Adds 3 differently named "Sacred Beast" monsters from your Deck to your hand, then you discard 2 cards; while in the GY it can banish itself to search a Level 10 Pyro, Thunder or Fiend monster that cannot be Normal Summoned.

22998.summary: Continuous Spell that can place two more copies of itself from hand, Deck and/or GY onto your field, reveal a Level 10 "Sacred Beast" to place a "Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts" from Deck, and can return itself from the GY to hand during the opponent's End Phase.

22999.summary: Field Spell that gives 500 ATK/DEF to monsters Normal or Special Summoned from the hand, spawns a "Mech Beast Token" on the opponent's field while searching a "Blitzclique" monster, and can return itself from the GY when a "Blitzclique" effect destroys a card.

23000.summary: Quick-Play Spell that either places a "Blitzclique" Continuous Trap from the Deck face-up or bounces a Thunder monster to destroy a card, and can return itself from the GY when a "Blitzclique" card destroys something.

23001.summary: Continuous Spell for "Blitzclique" that recovers a Thunder monster from the GY when your "Blitzclique" card destroys a card, can Special Summon a Thunder monster from hand (destroying itself), and returns itself from the GY.

23003.summary: Normal Spell that activates one of three effects — revive "Aiwass, Divine Spirit of the Law" from Deck or GY, send/banish an "Aleister" monster from the Deck, or banish a random face-down card from the opponent's Extra Deck — but locks you into Fusion Monster attacks.

23005.summary: If you control an "Artmage", "DoomZ", or "Elfnote" card, Special Summon "Medius the Pure" from hand or Deck (your opponent cannot respond), or banish this card from the GY to revive a Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Monster to a zone a Link Monster points to.

23010.summary: Draws a number of cards equal to the number of cards your opponent controls, then puts all but one of them back on the bottom of the Deck; you cannot activate another "Pot of Sloth" for the rest of the turn.

23018.summary: Continuous Trap that weakens the opponent's monsters by 300 ATK/DEF per Thunder monster you control, and can shuffle a "Blitzclique" card from hand or field into the Deck to search a differently named Thunder monster, or banish itself from the GY to search a "Blitzclique" Spell or "Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb".

23019.summary: Trap that Special Summons an "Invoked" monster from the Extra Deck by banishing an "Aleister" monster or Fusion Monster from the GY, at the cost of banishing it in the End Phase. While in the GY it can banish itself to revive a banished "Invoked" monster.

23020.summary: Normal Trap that Special Summons a "Power Patron" monster from hand, face-up Extra Deck, or GY, then banishes face-down from the opponent's Deck, field, or hand based on the number of Fusion/Synchro/Xyz card types you control.

23022.summary: With a "The Phantom Knights" monster in your field or GY you can activate it the turn it was Set: it Special Summons itself as a Normal Monster, optionally changes an opponent's Attack Position monster to Defense Position, and can be banished from the GY to Xyz Summon a DARK Xyz Monster.

23023.summary: Continuous Trap that can send an "S-Force" card from Deck to GY instead of banishing from hand for an "S-Force" cost, and when any card is banished can target and banish an opponent's field or GY card while repositioning an "S-Force" monster.

23024.summary: Trap that returns a "Melffy" monster from field or GY to the hand, then optionally Fusion Summons a Beast Fusion Monster, and if you control a "Melffy" Xyz Monster can banish itself from the GY to protect your Extra Deck "Melffy" monsters from opponent's activated effects.

23025.summary: Trap that, if you control a Tribute Summoned monster, lets you discard any number of cards to destroy that many face-up cards on the field; from the GY it can be banished along with Tributing an Extra Deck monster from hand or field to search a "Clown Crew" monster of a different Level/Rank.

23026.summary: Trap that, when your opponent activates a monster effect on their field during a turn they Special Summoned, destroys that monster and any of their cards in adjacent zones.

23027.summary: When activated, revives a banished monster to your rightmost Main Monster Zone; while face-up, the opponent must place their Main Monster Zone Summons in their leftmost usable zones.

23029.summary: Continuous Trap that halves all battle damage while you control 5 cards in your Spell & Trap Zone, lets you activate a Continuous Trap the turn it is Set, and during the Standby Phase Sets a random Continuous Trap from your Deck.

23036.summary: Continuous Spell that gains Full Moon Counters as monsters are destroyed by battle or effect, removing 1, 3 or 5 to revive a Fiend or Fairy, search a Level 10 DARK monster, or revive a Level 10 monster.

23141.summary: Special Summons itself from the hand by revealing 3 differently named Dragon monsters with 3000+ ATK in the Extra Deck; when sent to the GY it grants one Dragon Extra Deck monster targeting protection for the turn.

23144.summary: Level 12 monster that gains 1000 ATK/DEF per card in your hand, can discard 2 cards to Special Summon itself and search a coin-tossing card, and can negate an effect that adds from the Deck to the hand.

23145.summary: Cannot be Normal Summoned; Special Summons itself from hand or GY by Tributing a Level 7 or higher monster, and once per turn can mill a "Magnet Warrior" or "Magna Warrior" monster to drop its original ATK to 1500 and attack directly.

23147.summary: Fusion Monster that Special Summons an "Elemental HERO" from your Deck when it is Special Summoned, optionally burning for each opponent's card, and protects your other "Elemental HERO" monsters from destruction.

23148.summary: Normal Spell that destroys a monster you control to draw 2 and optionally change an opponent's monster's battle position, then can return itself from the GY to hand when a monster is Special Summoned from your GY.

23150.summary: Destroys a face-up Spell you control to draw a card, then can revive a "Destiny HERO" from hand, GY or banishment; from the GY it grants a second attack to an equipped monster or "Destiny HERO - Dogma".

23157.summary: Quick Effect: Tribute a monster (your opponent's if you control "Toon World") to Special Summon a monster that mentions "Toon World" from your hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

23158.summary: With "Toon World" up, Special Summons itself from the hand and can add or Set a "Toon" Trap from the Deck; also a Quick Effect that puts a card from either GY on the bottom of the Deck.

23159.summary: Hand trap that discards itself to either place "Mind Scan" from your hand or Deck onto your field, or recover and optionally Special Summon a monster from your GY that mentions "Toon World". Cannot be destroyed in battle by the monster it battles.

23160.summary: Fusion Toon Monster that Special Summons itself from the Extra Deck by shuffling its materials from hand, field, and/or GY into the Deck, lets your Toon monsters attack directly, recovers a "Toon" card or a card mentioning one from the GY each turn, and can banish an attacked Toon monster until the end of the Damage Step.

23161.summary: Field Spell treated as "Toon World" that adds any "Toon" card (or a card mentioning a "Toon" card) from your Deck up to three times per turn, and can briefly banish a Toon monster to protect an activation.

23162.summary: Continuous Trap that, while you have a "Toon" card in your field or GY, keeps your opponent's hand revealed and lets you look at their Set cards; with a Toon monster and a "Toon" Spell it can also declare a card name and negate that card's activated effects for the turn.

23163.summary: Witchcrafter hand extender: from your hand, recover a "Witchcrafter" card from your GY and Special Summon this card, locking you out of non-"Witchcrafter" Extra Deck Summons; also can Fusion Summon a "Witchcrafter" Fusion using materials from hand or field.

23164.summary: Can Tribute itself from the hand or field to search a "Witchcrafter" Field or Continuous Spell; if a face-up "Witchcrafter" monster you control leaves the field by an opponent's card effect while in the GY, Special Summons itself (banished when it leaves) and Tributes an opponent's monster.

23165.summary: Fusion Monster that when Fusion Summoned Special Summons up to 3 "Witchcrafter" monsters with different Attributes from the hand/Deck (locking you to Fusion Extra Deck Summons), and can revive itself from the GY in the End Phase by revealing a Spell.

23166.summary: Fusion Monster that can, as a Quick Effect during the Main or Battle Phase, either search a "Witchcrafter" Spell or copy the effect of a "Witchcrafter" Normal/Quick-Play Spell in your hand; during the End Phase, it returns a banished "Witchcrafter" card to the GY.

23167.summary: Quick-Play Spell that either destroys a "Witchcrafter" you control and an opponent's card, or Fusion Summons a "Witchcrafter" Fusion Monster by shuffling Spellcasters from your GY/banishment into the Deck; it can recover itself from the GY in the End Phase.

23168.summary: Field Spell that searches a "Witchcrafter" monster while discarding a card, and substitutes sending a "Witchcrafter" Spell/Trap from the Deck for discarding when activating a "Witchcrafter" monster's effect.

23169.summary: Counter Trap that negates the activation of a Spell/Trap or monster effect while you control a Level 5 or higher "Witchcrafter" monster; from the GY on a later turn it can banish itself to search a Level 5 or higher Spellcaster and then discard.

23170.summary: Hand trap-esque Fiend that discards itself during the Main Phase to Special Summon a Fiend from hand then destroy a card you control, and revives to hand or field from the GY when a card on the field is destroyed.

It also has a GY effect that lets you Special Summon a monster or Set a Trap from your GY if it is destroyed by an opponent's card effect.

23516.summary: Rank 4 Xyz that detaches a material during either Main Phase to attach a card from your hand, GY or banishment, and gains protection from destruction and an extra normal draw based on the Types attached to it.

23517.summary: Tuner that Special Summons itself from the GY or hand when a Spell/Trap on the field returns to the hand, and while on the field can Set a banished Normal Trap when another card returns to the hand.

23518.summary: Link 2 that can send a card you control to the GY to give all your WATER monsters 500 ATK/DEF for the turn, and from the GY banishes itself to revive a WATER monster when a WATER Link Monster you control is destroyed by an opponent's effect.

23519.summary: Fusion Monster that equips a Warrior from your GY/banishment or an opponent's monster as an Equip Spell granting 500 ATK/DEF, and can send an Equip Card to negate an opponent's Spell/Trap activation.

23520.summary: If Special Summoned from the Deck it searches a Level 4 or lower Rock monster, and if sent to the GY as Synchro Material it grants an immediate extra Normal Summon of a Rock monster.

23521.summary: Tuner monster that can be treated as a non-Tuner for Synchro Material, and on Normal or Special Summon summons another copy of itself from hand, Deck or GY as a LIGHT monster, locking you into LIGHT/DARK and Synchro-only Special Summons for the turn.

23522.summary: Synchro Monster that can banish an opponent's monster in its adjacent column or a Spell/Trap 2 columns away, mills an "Angelechy" card when placed in the Spell & Trap Zone, and while treated as a Continuous Spell limits both players to 1 activation per Chain.

23523.summary: Synchro Monster that when Special Summoned lets each player Special Summon a Fairy Synchro Monster from the Extra Deck with its effects negated and restrictions on using them as material, and negates an "Angelechy" monster's attack by giving control of itself to the opponent.

23524.summary: Searches an "Angelechy" Spell/Trap from the Deck but locks you out of Extra Deck Summons except LIGHT or DARK Synchro Monsters; from the GY it can banish itself to return an "Angelechy" Monster Card from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Extra Deck and optionally Special Summon it.

23525.summary: Returns an "Angelechy" Monster Card from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Extra Deck and can Special Summon it; from the GY it summons an "Angelechy" monster from the Extra Deck at the cost of sending a card from hand or field to the GY.

23526.summary: Special Summons one chosen "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck to your opponent's field and places another in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell; its GY effect shuffles "Angelechy" cards back into the Deck.

23527.summary: Field Spell that gains more effects the more "Angelechy" Monster Cards are in your Spell & Trap Zone, from a Standby Phase draw up to banishing opponent's Special Summoned monsters and Special Summoning an "Angelechy" monster from the Extra Deck.

23528.summary: A Trap that negates a face-up card's effects (with 1-4 "Angelechy" monsters) or banishes all of your opponent's cards (with 5+), and can banish itself from the GY to send an "Angelechy" card to the GY and place an "Angelechy" monster in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell.

23531.summary: When activated, each player can Special Summon 1 monster from hand in Attack Position, then all other face-up monsters are changed to face-down Defense Position; while it stays, you cannot Normal or Special Summon for the rest of the turn, and it can negate an attack to destroy a face-down opponent's card.

23532.summary: When Normal or Special Summoned, you can send this card to the GY to reveal Normal Monsters from your hand/Deck/field/GY and Set that many "Zenet" Spells from your Deck; during the opponent's turn it can banish itself from the GY to equip a Normal Monster to a Ritual Monster.

23533.summary: On Normal or Special Summon, sends itself to the GY to reveal up to 2 Normal Monsters from your hand, Deck, field or GY and Set that many "Zenet" Traps from the Deck; from the GY it can shuffle up to 3 Normal Monsters back into the Deck.

23534.summary: Level 12 Ritual Monster that can be Ritual Summoned with any "Zenet" card. It is unaffected by your opponent's activated effects while equipped, can discard itself to search any other "Zenet" card, and can flip the opponent's monsters face-down by sending a face-up Normal Monster you control to the GY, then revive a Normal Monster from your GY.

23535.summary: Ritual Monster that can be Ritual Summoned with any "Zenet" card, cannot be destroyed by card effects while equipped, can discard itself to send a "Zenet" card from Deck to GY, and can return opponent's cards to the hand by sending your face-up Normal Monsters to the GY.

23536.summary: Ritual Monster that can be Ritual Summoned with any "Zenet" card; cannot be destroyed by battle when equipped, can discard itself to recover a "Zenet" card from GY, and can Special Summon a face-up Normal Monster from the Spell/Trap Zone and equip itself to it.

23537.summary: Field Spell that once per turn can Ritual Summon a "Zenet" Ritual Monster by sending Normal Monsters from hand, Deck, or field to the GY, then equip a Normal Monster from the GY; also draws a card when you Special Summon a non-Token Normal Monster.

23538.summary: Adds a "Zenet" monster from your Deck to your hand; while in the GY, if you discard a "Zenet" Ritual Monster, you can banish this card to Special Summon a non-Effect Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck as a Normal Monster with restrictions.

23539.summary: Reveals 2 or 3 Normal Monsters from your hand, Deck, field or GY to Special Summon either a Level 8 or lower non-Effect Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck as a Normal Monster or a "Zenet" monster from your Deck or Normal Monster from your GY, then optionally draws 1 if a hand card was shown.

23540.summary: Normal Trap that Ritual Summons a "Zenet" Ritual Monster from your hand or GY by sending Normal Monsters with different names from hand, Deck, and/or face-up field to the GY, then can equip a Normal Monster from your GY to it. From the GY it protects Normal Monsters from destruction.

23541.summary: Normal Trap that negates the first monster effect activated in chosen opponent Main Monster Zones this turn, based on the number of Normal and "Zenet" Ritual Monsters you control; from the GY it can send an opponent's monster to the GY if your Normal Monsters' total ATK exceeds 3000.

23542.summary: A Counter Trap that negates and destroys an opponent's Spell/Trap activation while you control a Normal Monster or "Zenet" Ritual Monster, and can banish itself from the GY to Set a "Zenet" Spell/Trap if your Normal Monsters total more than 3000 ATK.

23543.summary: Level 7 monster that Special Summons itself when drawn or from the hand by placing another card on the bottom of the Deck, and during the Main Phase can draw 1 card at the cost of not adding other cards from the Deck that turn.

23544.summary: Level 7 Zombie that can Special Summon itself when drawn, can be Normal Summoned without Tribute at 700 original ATK, and on being Normal or Special Summoned from the hand draws a card while locking you into LIGHT Xyz Extra Deck Summons.

23545.summary: Can reveal and Special Summon itself when drawn, and when Normal or Special Summoned from the hand lets you draw a card at the cost of locking you into LIGHT Xyz Monsters; also Xyz Summons a Rank 7 LIGHT monster as a Quick Effect once per opponent's turn.

23546.summary: Level 7 that Special Summons itself when drawn and spins an opponent's monster to the bottom of the Deck, or can be discarded to draw a card at the cost of locking non-draw Deck additions.

23547.summary: When you draw this card, you can reveal it to Special Summon it and bounce an opponent's Spell/Trap; you can also discard it to draw 1, but you cannot add cards from the Deck that turn except by drawing.

23548.summary: Hand trap Quick Effect: discard it to either lock Extra Deck Special Summons to Rank 7 Xyz while drawing whenever the opponent adds a card, or simply draw 1; afterwards you cannot add cards from the Deck to hand for the rest of the Duel except by drawing.

23549.summary: Rank 7 Xyz that draws a card if it is sent to the GY by an opponent's card, and while in the Extra Monster Zone is unaffected by other effects, can turn an opponent's Deck-search effect into "Draw 1 card", and can detach a material to draw.

23550.summary: Rank 7 Xyz Monster that redirects your opponent's attacks to itself; on Xyz Summon or when a monster is Special Summoned from the hand, it detaches materials to spin that many of your opponent's cards to the bottom of the Deck, and attaches the top card of the opponent's Deck whenever they make a card leave it.

23551.summary: Places a "Raise Moon" card from your Deck on top of your Deck, then locks both players out of Deck searching for the turn; can be banished from the GY to draw a card.

23552.summary: Continuous Spell that protects your Level 7 "Raise Moon" monsters from the first destruction by card effect each turn, recycles your "Raise Moon" cards from the GY and banishment during the End Phase, and either cycles a hand card for a draw or draws a card with a Spellcaster "Raise Moon" Xyz Monster.

23553.summary: Normal Trap that Special Summons a "Raise Moon" Xyz Monster from the Extra Deck attaching this card, then can shuffle "Raise Moon" cards from GY into Deck; can be banished from GY to draw 1, but locks you out of adding cards from Deck to hand for the rest of the Duel.

23554.summary: Special Summons itself from hand when you control no monsters, banishes the top card of your Deck face-down on Summon, and can recover up to 2 face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" monsters from Main Phase at the cost of locking you into "Trirealm Rift" cards.

23555.summary: When Normal or Special Summoned, banishes the top 2 cards of your Deck face-down; it can Special Summon itself from the hand while you control a "Trirealm Rift" monster, and during your Main Phase recovers up to 2 face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" Spells/Traps at the cost of locking you into "Trirealm Rift" cards for the turn.

23556.summary: Trirealm Rift Psychic that banishes the top 3 cards of your Deck face-down on Summon, can Special Summon itself while the opponent has more monsters, and revives a face-down banished Level 5+ "Trirealm Rift" monster at the cost of locking you into Trirealm Rift effects.

23557.summary: Trirealm Rift extender that banishes the top 4 cards of your Deck face-down when Normal or Special Summoned, can Special Summon itself from the hand when the opponent Special Summons, and during the opponent's Main Phase revives a face-down banished Level 5 or higher "Trirealm Rift" monster at the cost of locking you into "Trirealm Rift" effects for the turn.

23558.summary: A Trirealm Rift monster that can banish itself face-down from the hand to recover a face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" card, banishes the top 5 cards of the Deck when Summoned, and negates an opponent's monster effect by shuffling back a matching face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" monster.

23559.summary: Quick Effect monster that banishes itself face-down from the hand to revive a face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" monster, and when Normal or Special Summoned banishes the top 6 cards of your Deck face-down while protecting your other "Trirealm Rift" cards from destruction and targeting.

23560.summary: Quick Effect hand trap that reveals itself with another "Trirealm Rift" card to banish both face-down and draw 2; on Summon it banishes the top 7 cards of your Deck face-down, and can shuffle a face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" monster back to swap an opponent's monster of the same Attribute.

23561.summary: When Normal or Special Summoned, banishes the top 8 cards of your Deck face-down; gains escalating effects based on the number of face-down banished cards, up to protection, popping, recovery and skipping Draw Phases.

23562.summary: Continuous Spell that banishes 5 cards from your GY and/or Deck to activate, grants an extra Normal Summon of a "Trirealm Rift" monster each Main Phase, and swaps a low-Level "Trirealm Rift" you control for a face-down banished high-Level one.

23563.summary: Field Spell that activates by banishing 5 cards from your GY and/or Deck face-down, recovers face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" cards to the hand each Main Phase, and locks the opponent out of activating cards during your turn once you control a Level 5+ "Trirealm Rift" monster with no cards in Deck.

23564.summary: When your opponent Summons a monster, banishes a face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" monster of the same Attribute to add it to your hand or Special Summon it, then locks you into "Trirealm Rift" cards; also, once per battle with no cards in your Deck, makes the battling opponent's monster's ATK 0.

23565.summary: Exodia monster that can Special Summon itself when drawn, then lock both players out of activating anything except "Exodia the Obliterator" for the turn while you cannot Normal or Special Summon; also destroys all opposing monsters when it battles and burns for their combined original ATK.

23566.summary: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set; it Special Summons itself from the hand by having 6 or more Insect monsters in your GY, bounces as many of your opponent's cards as possible on Summon, and shrinks your opponent's monsters whenever they Summon.

23567.summary: Harpie monster whose name becomes "Harpie Lady", Special Summons itself from hand while you control a WIND or EARTH monster, and on Summon Special Summons up to 2 Level 5 "Harpie" monsters from hand, Deck, and/or GY.

23568.summary: Blue-Eyes Fusion requiring 3 Blue-Eyes White Dragons; it is destructive-immune, unaffected by opponent's effects during their turn, can attack up to 3 times, and can destroy a Special Summoned or face-down opponent card up to 3 times per turn during the Battle Phase.

23569.summary: Level 7 that Normal Summons itself without Tribute with an empty field, searches a DARK Machine monster during your Main Phase, and can revive itself from the GY during the Battle Phase to gamble on destroying monsters.

23570.summary: Ritual Monster that redirects battle damage to your opponent, can Special Summon itself from hand as a Ritual Summon by Tributing 2 monsters, and during the Main Phase can negate an opponent's Effect Monster and equip it to itself as a 2000 ATK Equip Spell.

23571.summary: Level 8 Fiend that cannot be Normal Summoned and must be Special Summoned by card effect, easily summoning itself from hand with 3+ Fiend/Zombie monsters in the GY; when destroyed it returns to hand, steals an opponent's monster until the End Phase, and burns for half that monster's ATK.

23572.summary: Can be Special Summoned from the hand by Tributing 3 monsters, and if so your opponent sends all monsters they control to the GY; when sent to the GY, it adds a Warrior monster from Deck to hand during the End Phase.

23573.summary: Fusion Monster that gains 500 ATK per other monster on the field, can attack all opponent's monsters once each, and once per turn negates an opponent's Spell effect and can destroy a card.

23574.summary: Must be Special Summoned by Tributing 1 Level 7 or lower Spellcaster or Warrior monster. It survives the first destruction each turn, lets you draw back whenever your opponent draws (twice per turn), and negates all of your opponent's Spell Card activations while you hold 6+ cards.

23575.summary: If your opponent added a card from the Deck to the hand this turn outside the Draw Phase, inflict 400 damage per card in their hand, and if their hand, field and GY total 20+ cards you can banish their entire hand.

23576.summary: A Level 4 Warrior that loses you 500 LP and gains 500 ATK when it attacks, and can equip itself from the GY to a battle-destroying monster to rename and negate it and destroy your opponent's highest-ATK monster.

23577.summary: Special Summons itself from hand by revealing 3 EARTH monsters including itself; it can search a "Dragon Card" card from the Deck at the cost of discarding, and negates an opponent's field monster effect while granting itself protection if a WATER monster is on the field.

23578.summary: Special Summons itself from the hand by revealing 3 LIGHT monsters including itself, can reveal itself to search a "Dragon Card" card and discard, and can destroy an opponent's monster during the Main Phase while sending itself to the GY.

23579.summary: Continuous Spell that on activation searches a card with a die-roll effect from the Deck, and lets a player who rolls a 1 destroy up to 3 opponent monsters, destroy one monster and negate another's effects, or revive a monster from their GY.

23580.summary: Field Spell that gives a Summoned monster 1000 ATK/DEF while another monster with the same Type is on the field; if destroyed it negates the effects of all face-up monsters on the field and resets their ATK/DEF, and it can revive itself from the GY in the Standby Phase if the Field Zones are empty.

23581.summary: Continuous Trap that once per turn lets you declare a card name and reveal the top card of your Deck: a matching monster is Special Summoned and a matching Spell/Trap is Set, otherwise this card destroys itself; when destroyed by card effect it Special Summons a "Harpie" monster from the Deck or GY.

23582.summary: Can Special Summon itself from the hand while "Yami" or 2+ face-down cards are on the field; while you control a face-down card it is protected, and it can destroy a weaker monster that activates its effect or attacks.

23583.summary: Quick-Play Spell that sends a DARK or Zombie monster from hand, Deck, or field to the GY to weaken an opponent's Extra Deck Special Summoned monster and negate its effects if it is LIGHT, with Chain Link 3+ making it unrespondable.

23584.summary: Level 3 monster that can Special Summon itself from the hand while you control a card with a die-roll effect, can attack monsters twice per Battle Phase, and can roll a die to pump its ATK and possibly Summon another monster.

23585.summary: Quick-Play Spell that banishes a random card from the opponent's hand until the next Standby Phase; if it was Set and banished a monster, it then either strips copies from the opponent's hand/Deck/GY (Level 4 or lower) or adds a matching Level 5+ monster from your Deck.

23586.summary: Hand trap/Quick Effect: send it from hand to GY to draw then discard, lowering all opponent's monsters' ATK by 500 for the turn; while in the GY it revives itself when your Fiend monster destroys a monster by battle, but is banished when it leaves the field.

23587.summary: Gearfried monster that can Special Summon itself from hand after your monster was destroyed, equipping a monster from your GY with 800 ATK, then can destroy its equips to search a same-Attribute-and-Type monster of a different Level from the Deck.

23588.summary: Quick-Play Spell: pay 1000 LP and target an opponent's face-up monster to either destroy it or Tribute Summon a monster using it as tribute; it can also banish itself from the GY in your Main Phase to search another copy from the Deck.

23589.summary: Negates an opponent's card or effect that Special Summons from the GY, then gives them a monster from their GY before sending face-up monsters they control to the GY with total ATK up to 6000. If banished, it returns to your hand and lets you Normal Summon a Tribute-requiring monster without Tributing.

23808.summary: Can equip itself from the hand or GY to a face-up monster, granting it 2100 ATK/DEF while your LP are 4000 or less, and can negate an opponent's resolved activated effect while you control a die-roll card, then banish itself.
